subject: sci-dym
title: SCI.DYM.------PRI.INFO.
description: Third diagram on page 368 (R(AS)CM(II)-12) — a distinctive crossing in which only the two crossing-axis terms (R)SCI-DYM and PRI-INFO are labeled; the diagram's nine internal junction points sit as unlabeled black-dot nodes connected in a recursive branching pattern. (R)SCI-DYM (the reality of scientific dynamism — the form's scientific-dynamic working in actual operation) is crossed with PRI-INFO (principle information). SCI-DYM sits on the left with the subject-arrow; PRI-INFO sits at top-center as partner-axis. From the central junction the diagram fans into approximately nine unlabeled terminal nodes via a recursive tree of internal junctions. Structural argument: the structural payload is precisely the unlabeled-leaf form — the diagram depicts the *unspecified branching multiplicity* that scientific-dynamism crossed with principle-information produces. Where the prior two diagrams on this page name specific outputs (TH-CONT-DYM, PROJ-CONT, EXT-DYM; PROJ-DYM, SOC-RT-DY, PHY-U-P, POL-DYM, MT-INFO), this one withholds the leaf-names because the structural claim is that scientific-dynamism × principle-information produces a *generic branching* — any number of unspecified outputs that depend on the local information-regulation conditions. The 'distortive redefining agent' that information-dynamics has become (per the prior page's prose) is structurally this: the leaves are unnamed because the regulation supplies the names case-by-case. The crossing's working content is the *form* of the multiplicity, not its specifics.
